description: AVEVA E3D HVAC element types to PMEF @type and componentClass (RFC-0014). Separate from native-types-e3d because keywords such as CAP mean different parts in piping and HVAC. The first entry whose conditions hold wins. Element types without a specific PMEF type map to pmef:GenericDuctComponent, so no component is dropped.
notes: Element types as found in the Huldra test case (issue #55); no vendor data.
An HVAC element type that is not listed is exported as pmef:GenericDuctComponent with componentClass SPECIAL and a warning.

entries.note: Branch connector; the branch port is derived from the geometry if the export has none
Meaning not documented publicly; kept with its keyword
